'''Zaprid's Caravan''' was a traveling [[Black market/Legends|black market]] bazaar. It was a small fleet of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]] that traveled between backwater [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Zaprid]] preferred to keep the caravan away from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] space, and the caravan attained a reputation for bilking hustlers and peasants in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]].
